text: Ancy-Dornot, pronounced [ɑ̃si dɔʁno] in French and known as Anzig-Dorningen in German, is a commune located in the Moselle department of northeastern France. It was officially established on 1 January 2016 through the merger of the former communes of Ancy-sur-Moselle and Dornot.
